_comment: Component Inventory fields that can't live on a GitHub repo. Everything here is optional. `repoExtras` adds or overrides fields for a repo-backed component (dates, comments, a display name that differs from the repo name); topics still win for the fields they cover, so curate on GitHub where you can. `nonRepo` holds components with no repo of their own — third-party services, vendor platforms, hardware.

partner-portal.comment: Superseded by the Partner API on the edge gateway. Kept live for existing integrations until they migrate.

recommendations-service.comment: Repo created, implementation not started. Scheduled for Q2.
